project_name: EduPath India – AI Career Guidance Platform

design_philosophy.theme_strategy: Light Mode Dominant (Education/Clarity) with High-Contrast Text

rules: Use Clash Display for Hero sections and major headings to give a 'Modern Institutional' feel.
Use Plus Jakarta Sans for all long-form text and UI elements for maximum legibility.
Avoid 'Inter' for headings. It makes the site look like a generic SaaS.

primary.description: Deep Indigo - Represents Knowledge, Depth, and Authority.

secondary.description: Indian Marigold - Represents Success, Auspiciousness, and Warmth.

accent.description: Growth Teal - Used for progress bars, success states, and fresh starts.

background.description: Warm Off-White - Mimics paper/books, easier on eyes than pure white.

accessibility.rule: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all body text. Use dark indigo (#1e1b4b) for text instead of pure black for better readability.

bento_grid.description: Use for Student Dashboard. Mix of square and rectangular cards.

career_path_tree.description: Visual representation of career steps. Do not use a simple list.
career_path_tree.implementation: Use a vertical timeline with branching nodes. Use SVG lines to connect steps.

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-6 py-4 border-2 border-[#1e1b4b]/10 hover:bg-[#1e1b4b]/5 transition-all

cards.style: bg-white border border-[#1e1b4b]/10 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300

inputs.style: h-12 rounded-lg border-gray-200 focus:border-[#1e1b4b] focus:ring-[#1e1b4b]/20 bg-[#f9fafb]

visual_enhancers.grain_overlay: opacity-5 mix-blend-overlay pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 url('https://grainy-gradients.vercel.app/noise.svg')

images.description: Modern Indian student with laptop - use for Landing Page Hero
Large institutional building with flag - use for Government College Directory header
Graduate celebrating - use for 'Success Stories' or completion steps
Classroom full of students - use for 'Community' or 'About Us'
Woman using mobile phone - use for 'Mobile Accessibility' feature section
Abstract lines - use for background of 'Career Roadmap' section

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for Marketing Pages, but Shadcn components for the Dashboard.
The 'Career Roadmap' is the core feature. Spend extra effort making it visual. It should look like a Metro Map or a Tree, not a list.
Ensure the Chatbot is accessible via a floating action button (FAB) on mobile.
Strictly follow the color palette. Do not introduce random colors.
The 'Government' aspect implies trust. Avoid overly chaotic layouts. Keep it structured.
Remember to create .jsx files, not .tsx files.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Do NOT center align the App container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
